author: kpedro88
body:
#### PR description:

Thanks to @hoyongjeong, with support from @cms-sw/mtd-dpg-l2, for this very nice work!

The MTD subdetectors (BTL and ETL) are introduced in FastSim using the tracker approach:
* geometry objects
* SimHit producer
* dedicated physics models (initially cloned from tracker and then customized for MTD materials and physics processes)
* some related code in FastSimProducer generalized to be reused for both cases (tracker and MTD)

The hit collections are propagated through digitization and (tracking) reconstruction. The FastSim `RecoTrackAccumulator` is extended to merge more collections needed for some MTD tracking reco sequences, following the example of `TrackCollectionCloner` in FullSim. Some FastSim code is incidentally modernized to better follow CMS code rules.

#### PR validation:

Workflow 36434.0 runs successfully.
